name: Roomba Max 875 Combo
description: iRobot's most powerful Roomba to date, and the first flagship launched since the company's 2025–2026 bankruptcy and acquisition. Notably switches from iRobot's traditional camera-based navigation to dual-line LiDAR, paired with a self-washing, hot-water dock.

specs.label: Weight
specs.note: ~5.45 kg — robot body only, excludes AutoWash dock; official iRobot spec

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.note: 14.17 × 14.02 × 3.93 in; climbs thresholds up to 3.5cm — official iRobot spec

specs.label: Navigation
specs.note: dual-line LiDAR — a shift from iRobot's usual camera nav

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: iRobot's legacy "Select" hardware-subscription ($14.99–$29.99/mo) closed to new customers in 2024 and isn't offered for this Sept 2026 launch; core app mapping/scheduling remain free

sourcing: Specs sourced from iRobot's own September 2, 2026 press release (media.irobot.com) and Engadget's launch coverage, as of September 2026. Battery runtime, charging time, dustbin/water-tank capacities, and noise level (dB) were not stated in either source and are omitted rather than estimated. iRobot's ownership changed via Chapter 11 bankruptcy and a January 2026 sale to Shenzhen Picea Robotics — noted above since it's directly relevant to buyers evaluating this brand. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: MSRP **$1,199**. Announced September 2, 2026, available immediately at irobot.com with wider North American retail rolling out later that month, alongside a lower-tier "Roomba Plus 678 Combo."

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: The Max 875 Combo replaces iRobot's usual camera-based vSLAM with "ClearView Pro" dual-line LiDAR and PrecisionVision AI, claiming 300+ obstacle types. PowerSpin Max roller mop is 44% larger, spinning at 300 RPM with 18N pressure, plus ThermaMist stain pre-treatment and carpet auto-lift. AutoWash dock self-empties, washes, and dries the mop. Battery, capacity, and noise figures are unpublished.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: **Important context for this listing:** iRobot filed prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy on December 16, 2025, and completed a court-supervised sale on January 23, 2026 to **Shenzhen Picea Robotics** — its own former contract manufacturer and largest creditor — with Nasdaq shares delisted and no equity for prior shareholders. The Max 875 Combo is the first flagship launched under this new ownership: buyers are now purchasing from a Chinese-owned subsidiary of iRobot's former manufacturing partner, not the original Nasdaq-listed company.

firmwareCommunity.note: iRobot has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API for the Roomba Max 875 Combo. Its newer V4 protocol is explicitly not yet supported by dorita980 (the LAN-control library cataloged in Builds & Mods, which covers Roomba 600 series through Combo 10 Max), and the Roomba-MQTT-Integration project targets only older offline 600/700/800 models. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
